# Radoslav Radev Recommends Planche Lean Presses As The Best Exercise For Planche Progression From His Own Practice

Radoslav Radev recommends planche lean presses as the best exercise for planche progression, based on his own practice and teaching. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:00]

## Details

- He says planche lean presses boost progress five times more than what most people are doing. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:00]
- The exercise imitates the planche in position, direction of pushing, and feeling. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:10]
- It teaches the most important planche rule: to be high above the ground always when you do planche. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:26]
- It prepares you for the planche press to handstand from day one. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:38]
- It works for every progression: planche lean, tuck planche, advanced tuck planche, pike planche, straddle planche. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:55]
- To do it correctly: start in a push-up position on parallettes slightly wider than shoulders, rotate the biceps forward, point the toes, squeeze the core with posterior pelvic tilt and glutes, slide the feet forward, and lean forward and up until the wrist is in one line with the lower back. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 01:11]
- Push through only the shoulders to the pike position, then return slow and controlled. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 03:10]
- You can do four sets after the planche workout, or on a conditioning day. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 06:37]
- His advice is to not think about a lot of reps more than 10 reps, and focus on quality, slow and controlled. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 07:17]
- The common mistakes are: not leaning enough (wrist not in line with lower back), not being high above the ground, and doing it too fast. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 07:45]

## Evidence

- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:26 (Radoslav Radev): "Second, it teaches you the most important planche rule about the technique. The rule to be high above the ground always when you do planche"
- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 00:38 (Radoslav Radev): "Third, it imitates the planche press to handstand and actually the best exercise that you can do to improve your planche after you achieve it is the planche press and the exercise planche lean presses preparing you for the planche press to handstand from day one"
